trigger_condition: Hidden-input chooser is canceled without firing `change`
guard_snippet: const finish = (file: File | null) => { input.remove(); resolve(file); }; input.addEventListener('change', () => finish(input.files?.[0] ?? null), { once: true }); window.addEventListener('focus', () => queueMicrotask(() => finish(input.files?.[0] ?? null)), { once: true });
potential_consequence: Fallback browsers never return control after canceling the chooser.

trigger_condition: Older file read finishes after a newer selection
guard_snippet: const selectionId = createCorrelationId(); pendingSelectionRef.current = selectionId; const text = await file.text(); if (pendingSelectionRef.current !== selectionId) return; await beginWorkerImport(sourceKind, { ...payload, textContent: text }, selectionId);
potential_consequence: The preview can flip back to an older, slower file.

trigger_condition: Large file reading exceeds the budget before `beginImport` runs
guard_snippet: const correlationId = createCorrelationId(); storeRef.current.getState().commands.beginImport(correlationId, sourceKind); scheduleBudgetTimer(); const binaryContent = await file.arrayBuffer(); if (!isCurrentSelection(correlationId)) return; ensureWorker().postMessage(...);
potential_consequence: No progress state appears while the shell is busy reading the file.

trigger_condition: Worker bootstrap or runtime error never yields a typed envelope
guard_snippet: workerRef.current.onerror = workerRef.current.onmessageerror = () => { clearBudgetTimer(); storeRef.current.getState().commands.failImport({ code: 'import.preview.worker-failed', title: 'Preview worker failed', detail: 'The import worker could not start or respond.', retryable: true }, storeRef.current.getState().activeCorrelationId ?? undefined); };
potential_consequence: Import can remain stuck in parsing until the user manually refreshes.
